lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Earl Guzman is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Earl is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Earl Guzman is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Earl kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Earl's gone." Wei looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Earl." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Thao blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Research & Records (Level 1). Find information fast: indexes, archives, and asking the right question.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Earl Guzman, 41 days. The mantle passes to Thao Simmons.

d41: The fire knew Thao before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
